comparison.objective: Align a torqued castle nut's slot by further tightening and insert a cotter pin.
comparison.physical_skill: Rotate a castellated nut in the permitted direction, align a cross-hole, and insert a pin.
comparison.success_condition: Nut tightened to alignment and pin passed through; backing off more than 5 degrees irreversibly fails. No complete task spec is available beyond the body.
comparison.reason: Both involve rotational adjustment and securing a setting, but this record tests one-way nut tightening plus pin insertion. The candidate instead loosens a captive screw, removes/reacquires a hex bit after collar motion, relocks, and proves a tuned dynamic response over repeated impacts.
